notes.title: Demo Update #1: Compendium, Card Buffs, Bugfixes & more
notes.content:
[p][b]Thank you all for playing the pre-alpha prototype![/b][/p][p]We’ve reviewed your feedback and are actively working on improvements.[/p][p]As some of you mentioned in your feedback that you'd like to look up keywords, we've created the Compendium.[/p][p]In the Compendium, you can track all the cards you've already played. We also keep track of whether you've completed runs using these cards. In the future, cards from completed runs will be marked accordingly.[/p][p]Feel free to complete your Compendium. And if you do, we’d love to see a screenshot! 😊
[/p][h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Added Basic Compendium[/b]: view all Cards, Soul Shards, and Keywords you've seen and used during your playthrough[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562608/6545e33fbca9dc225d4f153f2d275e0ad30d3d6e.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]General Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Language is now automatically selected on the first game launch[/p][/*][*][p]Various text improvements and typo fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Cards now show Tooltips for[/p][list][*][p]effects on cards they reference[/p][/*][*][p]effects that are referenced by another effect (like increase)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Tutorial Step: Teaches how to use your heal flask without consuming Energy while on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]General tooltips are now larger for improved readability.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] [i]Corrosive Venom[/i] now correctly goes to the [b]void[/b] instead of the [b]discard pile[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] Insecure + Outbreak no longer results in an unintended instant win combo[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] Broken tooltip at Smithy[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] Wrong base value on some cards with modifiers[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] Blizzard echo calculation[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] Preview for cards with echo (previously only worked for damage)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed:[/b] Some cards showing broken or irrelevant tooltips[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3][p][b]Gameplay & Decks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved [i]Pride[/i] starter deck[/p][list][*][p][i]Celestial Dart[/i]: Reverted to [b]4 damage[/b] when the condition is met[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved merchant card selection[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Various Card Buffs and Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Borrowed Strength[/b] (3018)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spite[/b] (3026)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Outbreak[/b] (3034)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Glyph of Weakening[/b] (3040)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Glyph tags.feature: Added Basic Compendium: view all Cards, Soul Shards, and Keywords you've seen and used during your playthrough

tags.bug: Fixed: Corrosive Venom now correctly goes to the void instead of the discard pile
Fixed: Insecure + Outbreak no longer results in an unintended instant win combo
Fixed: Wrong base value on some cards with modifiers
Fixed: Preview for cards with echo (previously only worked for damage)
Fixed: Some cards showing broken or irrelevant tooltips

tags.balance_change: Celestial Dart: Reverted to 4 damage when the condition is met
